original_mips_evidence.raw_validation: Parsed all 29 target words by ROM/VMA comments; exact bytes match both SHA-verified private retail USA and decompressed reference slices.
original_mips_evidence.stack_and_signature: Subtracts 0x18 from sp and saves ra at sp+0x14. No incoming argument is read. Five callers invoke with jal/nop and discard v0; void func_8000394C(void) is inferred from these call sites, not recovered original source typing.
branch_matrix: Call 80036908 with the word D_8006D328 loaded into a0 in the jal delay slot.
A nonzero v0 branches to the epilogue; the branch delay slot materializes byte value 5, but no target stores use it on this path.
A zero v0 stores byte 5 at 0x800C7CDD, calls 80003880 with halfword 1 stored at 0x800C7A76 in the jal delay slot, then reloads D_8015C5C8 and increments byte SYS_W+0x3ADD6.
The target has no internal loop/back edge and does not directly write SYS_W stepw at +0x3ADD4 or stepw_end at +0x3ADD5.

gate_contract.body: 80036928 is 140 bytes at ROM [0x37528,0x375B4), SHA-256 f0c062df83ce9007ca3e6d180663f774f2db2193fe6f8a85f8e30bb496e6905d. It reads a pointer at SYS_W+0x3B014. Null returns zero. Otherwise it reads pointee byte +0x10: 0xFF calls osViBlack(1) and returns zero; values below 0xEF advance by 16 and return one; values 0xEF..0xFE saturate to 0xFF, call osViBlack(1), and return one.
gate_contract.argument_note: The target passes D_8006D328 in a0. The helper stores incoming a0 in its argument area but does not reload it in the 140-byte body; no effect from that argument was established.
